## Interfaces

plan-phase one phase-scoped oracle-author + freeze (`test_ids`/`oracle_hashes`/`verify_command`); execute-phase frozen-oracle brief + `project:oracle-amendment` requested→approved/rejected (parent updates freeze); verify-work mechanical oracle verify + close-batch wiring; `aff check` writes `failing_node_ids` + body tail; `close_batch` gates via `oracle_red.is_assertion_level_red` and green-revision hash match / approved `new_hashes`; contract `records` only — acceptance optional freeze fields and `oracle-amendment` (current-status, Reason/Change, status enum, refs).

## Assumptions

claim-witnesses store-backed red/green + dirty-red ancestry remain; pytest assertion tails are parseable; legacy acceptances without freeze fields skip oracle gates; finding escape still bypasses red-first/oracle gates (pre-existing close escape).

## Invariants

Oracle author ≠ executor (skills); frozen hashes are close authority (silent drift refused); assertion-level red required for freeze and oracle-backed done close; parent-only freeze/amendment/assessment writes; no duplicate `record_types` catalog.

## Conflicts

none — prior dual-catalog finding cleared (`record_types` removed; freeze/amendment live only under `records`).
